user.title: MatrixPortal display OTA
user.description: Home Assistant fetches signed firmware releases and pushes them to the displays over the LAN. The token stays here — the boards never talk to GitHub.

data_description.token: A fine-grained personal access token with Contents: Read on that repository and nothing else.
data_description.base_topic: Must match the base topic set in each display's web portal.

error.invalid_auth: GitHub refused the token. It needs Contents: Read on that repository.
error.no_release: No release found. Check the repository name, and that the token can see it.

abort.already_configured: That repository is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. Only one instance is needed.

init.title: Address override
init.description: Leave this empty for the usual case: addresses are discovered from the displays themselves, so a board that moves is followed and a new one joins on its own.

data_description.host_override: Space-separated. Set this only to pin the list — to reach a board that has dropped off MQTT, or to update one on purpose while leaving the others alone.

update.name: Update firmware
update.description: Fetches a signed release and pushes it to every display that is not already on it.

only.name: Only this display
only.description: Device id, such as matrix-a1b2c3. Leave empty for all of them.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Report what would happen, and change nothing.

refresh_latest.name: Refresh latest version
refresh_latest.description: Asks GitHub for the newest release and republishes it to the retained topic the displays' Firmware entities read.
